units.source_text: 古诗云：‘此身生意尽’，信哉斯言。”

en.t: An old poem says, 'All hope of living in this body is gone'; how true those words are.

units.source_text: 源氏公子接得空蝉来信，甚是珍爱。

en.t: Prince Genji received a letter from Utsusemi and treasured it deeply.

units.source_text: 他对此人还是恋恋不忘。

en.t: He still could not forget her and remained deeply attached.

units.source_text: 便复书道：“叹‘此身生意尽’者，应是何人？

en.t: So he wrote back, 'Who can it be who laments that all hope of living in this body is gone?'
